as_told.title: Epstein's Zorro Ranch near retired Los Alamos physicists

plain: The financier Jeffrey Epstein is said to have set up his Zorro Ranch in New Mexico around 1993 so that he could be near retiring physicists from Los Alamos, the US nuclear weapons laboratory in that state. Michels raises it on four episodes and sources it to an interview Epstein gave the political strategist Steve Bannon near the end of his life, which Michels dates to 2019. Michels uses it to argue that security at the Department of Energy, the agency that runs the lab, was so lax that a private man could set out to get close to its scientists.
